fields.Name: C1 → C2.1
fields.Description: Gate G7.1 (owner PR 1, phase 7, dataset C1, criterion C2.1): on the MoreCheese people behind scenario C1, changing the job-title prompt, its AI model or a parameter forces recomputation of 100% of the affected values, and an expired entry is recomputed. Runs the installed job-title pipeline cloned onto a deterministic stub driver over 52 fixture people carrying the 52 golden titles; no model calls.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Template, model and parameter changes each recompute 52/52 people (100%); an expired cache entry is refreshed in place and served on the next hit.
